channel.title: Hardware :: Swing Catalyst Support
channel.description: Set up and configure hardware devices that integrate with Swing Catalyst, including pressure plates, launch monitors, and diagnostics tools. Pressure Plates Install, calibrate, and configure balance plates and BodiTrak sensors. Launch Monitors Connect FlightScope, Foresight, Trackman, and other launch monitors. Diagnostics & Setup Calibration diagnostics, force plate troubleshooting, and hardware setup.
